pages.raw_title: Venue® Data Room | Smart & Secure Virtual Deal Rooms | DFIN
pages.raw_meta: Award winning virtual data room optimized for security, productivity, usability & cost transparency. Securely share documents and accelerate the deal process.
raw_blocks: Own the Room with DFIN Venue

DFIN Venue sets the bar for responsive, intuitive, and innovative virtual data room solutions by merging reliable technology with best-in-class service. This virtual data room platform is designed for transactions that require speed, security and scalability.

DFIN is the virtual data room provider trusted by countless businesses to support their global, mission-critical transactions. It’s built for deals that can’t afford delays or data risk, with exceptional high-volume performance as well as streamlined reviewer onboarding. Our live deal experts are available 24/7/365 to assist whenever you have questions or concerns.
Discover the leading virtual data room providers for:
of the Top 100 investment banks
of the Top 100 private equity firms
Due-diligence content pages hosted annually
See the Power of DFIN Venue:
Save valuable time by expanding every folder and file with one click, which prevents users from being overwhelmed by a confusing file management architecture.
Create better stakeholder experiences by delivering ready-to-use data rooms that facilitate easier communication and feature easy-to-use interfaces.
Work more efficiently by viewing the cover page of documents so you can ensure you have the right ones at first glance.
Get new data rooms faster by creating them yourself as they are needed.
Safeguard data room content by optimizing group and user privileges so only authorized users have access.
Instantly find documents and insights across large deal rooms with advanced algorithms that enable predictive document relevance, automated folder structuring, and automatic risk identification.
Monitor user activity, document views and engagement metrics to drive deals faster and with greater responsivity and visibility.
Increase productivity by erasing sensitive data using data room tools so there's no risk of confidential details being leaked by accident.
Organize and update data rooms by uploading and moving items anywhere.
15 minutes is plenty of time to see if DFIN Venue is a fit for your team
Leverage the Power of DFIN Active Intelligence™

Introducing Active Intelligence™ — a transformative suite of AI capabilities thoughtfully designed to help deal teams navigate complex, document-intensive transactions. Embedded directly within Venue®, AI Document Summaries and AI Document Translation help accelerate due diligence, reduce manual review effort, improve cross-border collaboration, and keep sensitive workflows secure and governed within the data room.

Support clients during IPOs, mergers, and acquisitions. Venue virtual deal rooms can simplify complex workflows such as IPO due diligence, M&A deal structuring, and cross-border compliance reviews. The Venue VDR reduces friction for multi-jurisdictional deal reviews, enabling seamless collaboration among buyers, counsel, and regulators. With Venue, you can accelerate the time-to-close with version control and audit trails to ensure compliance every step of the way.

Streamline fundraising, investments, and exits. With Venue, you can manage limited partners (LP) reporting, portfolio company document sharing and exit prep in a single, consistent platform. Venue is the leading virtual data room software providing scalablility to accommodate multiple companies and deals, with role-based access to ensure control. It offers the highest degree of performance across mega-funds and high-volume file sharing, as well.

Support transactions across the corporate lifecycle. Centralize your workflows for board governance, regulatory audits, and multi-division transaction support. Venue is an M&A-ready platform that adapts as your strategy evolves.

The Venue virtual data room features bank-grade security for sensitive information, including robust encryption, multi-factor authentication, and role-based access control. This secure document sharing ensures you can prevent unauthorized downloading, printing, or viewing that can create unwanted complications.
These tools are compliant with global regulatory standards including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR and more.
With advanced monitoring tools to track activity on confidential documents and built-in audit trails for full deal transparency, Venue makes every transaction as safe and secure as possible.
SOC 2 Type II Audits
AES 256-bit Encryption at Rest & in Transit
Intrusion Prevention (IPS) and Detection (IDS) Systems

raw_blocks: Donnelley Financial Solutions (DFIN) is the leading provider of innovative, software and technology-enabled financial regulatory and compliance solutions.

We provide regulatory filing and deal solutions to public and private companies, mutual funds, and other regulated investment firms. We support every stage of our clients' business and investment lifecycles.
Our core values and corresponding leadership behaviors guide our interaction with shareholders, clients, and employees.
We navigate constantly changing market conditions in order to help our clients succeed.
We create the best solutions by leveraging diverse perspectives, sharing knowledge, and fostering an inclusive environment in which all voices are heard.
We adhere to the highest standards of integrity, quality, and transparency in all that we do.
We are confident and willing to push boundaries to pursue innovative and unconventional solutions.
DFIN is led by professionals who bring many perspectives and experiences to the table.
We’ve had the pleasure of working with amazing clients, but here are just a few.

Become part of a team that is shaping global markets and work in an environment where you can bring your whole self to work and do your best work every day. DFIN is a values-based culture in which you can build a rewarding career.

At DFIN, we believe there is power in our collective genius. It takes diverse voices, perspectives, and ways of thinking to deliver the best solutions for our clients. We seek those voices out and create an inclusive environment in which they are heard and valued.

Our foundation is built upon delivering trusted solutions to our clients through responsible and sustainable business practices. We are committed to upholding environmental, health, and safety standards in all that we do. We believe a dedication to sustainability is critical for economies and for all global citizens.

DFIN provides regulatory filing and deal solutions via its software, technology-enabled services, and print and distribution solutions to public and private companies, mutual funds, and other regulated investment firms.
